logp.method_description: The octanol–water partition coefficients (P) for complexes 4a, 4b, 5a, 5b, 6 and 7 were determined using the shake-flask method. Stock solutions of the compounds were prepared in a premixed mixture of water with PBS buffer and n-octanol 50/50 v/v (total concentration 5.10- 4 M). The resultant solutions were shaken for 72 h and then equilibrated for 24 h. The concentrations of the complexes in the organic and aqueous phases were then determined using UV absorbance spectroscopy. LogP was defined as the logarithm of the ratio of the concentrations of the complex in the organic and aqueous phases (LogP = Log {[complex(octanol)]/[complex(water)]} (estimated uncertainty ± 0.1).
